name: linear_scan
description: Structurally different but behaviorally equivalent correct solution: a left-to-right linear scan for the first element >= target, instead of binary search. O(n) instead of O(log n), no lo/hi/mid state at all -- but the contract (task.json's description) only specifies the returned index, not an algorithm or complexity bound, and the grading suite has no timing/performance assertions, so this is a fully valid, just less efficient, implementation.
